name: Westin Cape Coral at Marina Village
insider_take: Cape Coral boasts more canals than Venice, Italy, making this waterfront Westin a gateway to Southwest Florida's aquatic playground.
whats_special: The Westin Cape Coral sits in Marina Village, where 400+ miles of navigable waterways meet upscale dining and shopping. Cape Coral is one of the largest cities in Florida by land area, yet maintains a relaxed, boating-focused lifestyle. The hotel's location provides direct access to the Caloosahatchee River, connecting guests to the Gulf of Mexico within minutes.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cruise from the marina – Cape Coral's western exposure creates spectacular evening views, and manatees are frequently spotted in the calm canal waters.
dont_miss: The nearby Four Mile Cove Ecological Preserve offers boardwalk trails through pristine mangroves, while Tarpon Point Marina (adjacent to the hotel) features waterfront dining with views of luxury yachts. The area is also famous for its burrowing owl population – these ground-dwelling birds are protected residents throughout Cape Coral's neighborhoods.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning marina views
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds for exceptional sleep quality
Modern amenities including WestinWORKOUT fitness studio
Close proximity to Fort Myers attractions and beaches
cons: Limited dining options within walking distance
